answer_1.quote: We propose AdMIRaL (Autoregressive document Multi-hop Information Retrieval with Natural Logic-guidance), a novel multi-hop document retriever for RnR that consists of two components: i) a retriever that jointly scores documents in the KB and sentences reranked from previously retrieved documents using an autoregressive formulation, ii) a proof system using Natural Logic to assess the sufficiency of the evidence retrieved to verify a given claim, and terminate the retrieval of further documents.
tasks: Other:Document Retrieval with Natural Language Generation
answer_1.outputs: document titles and natural logic proofs generated autoregressively

answer_4.quote: To explore the interpretability of our sufficiency proofs, we conduct a forward prediction experiment. Human subjects are asked to predict whether AdMIRaL considers the evidence for a given claim to be sufficient or not, by using the generated sufficiency proof.
